empty: Remove everything else: the bed and all bedding, the headboard, both bedside tables, the lamps, the rug, the curtains and all objects. Keep the doorway on the right.
keep: the plaster walls and ceiling, the stone floor, the floor-to-ceiling glass on the left with the tropical garden outside, the doorway on the right, and the sunlight and leaf shadows
